summary: Expose the distinction between prescribed plate separation, newly formed crust and a computed geodynamic solution.
objective: Make a ridge cross-section with two separating plates and age bands that record when crust was created.
intent_signals: Make a ridge cross-section with two separating plates and age bands that record when crust was created.
Expose the distinction between prescribed plate separation, newly formed crust and a computed geodynamic solution.
example_prompts: Make a ridge cross-section with two separating plates and age bands that record when crust was created.
Create an explorable 3D explanation of seafloor spreading with rate and age ruler.
negative_signals: No mantle rheology, melting, cooling subsidence, bathymetry prediction or earthquake dynamics.
not_for: No mantle rheology, melting, cooling subsidence, bathymetry prediction or earthquake dynamics.

entities.name: Ridge cutaway
entities.guidance: Build two plate slabs with a narrow central creation zone, simplified upper mantle and a cut side face; mark vertical exaggeration and layers as schematic.

entities.name: Crust parcels
entities.guidance: Use contiguous age bands born in matched left/right pairs; their colors encode age, not naturally visible rock stripes.

entities.name: Rate and age ruler
entities.guidance: Show one-side half-rate u versus full separation rate 2*u, model time and a selected parcel age-distance relation.

state_contract.model: Schematic symmetric spreading with fixed ridge at x=0 and prescribed half-rate u>0 on each side. New parcels are created at the ridge and advect as x=side*u*(t-birthTime); age=t-birthTime.
state_contract.authority: Parcel birth times, side IDs and the prescribed rate own age labels and positions. The model does not solve mantle convection or plate forces.
actions: Pause and select matching age bands.
Change rate only by restarting or by recording a rate history.

invariants: Paired parcels born together have equal age and equal distance from the ridge in the symmetric model.
Full separation rate is twice the prescribed half-rate.
Changing playback speed does not change simulated age-distance relations.
motion_guidance: Create crust at the ridge as plates separate rather than revealing empty voids under an unchanged old surface.
If magnetic polarity bands are added, use a declared polarity-time input; do not fabricate real reversal dates.
known_limits: No mantle rheology, melting, cooling subsidence, bathymetry prediction or earthquake dynamics.
Symmetric constant-rate spreading is an illustrative assumption, not a universal property of real ridges.
Curated recipe only; no runtime scene or rendered behavior has been verified for this record.

claims.statement: At divergent plate boundaries, plates move apart and new crust forms; seafloor magnetic patterns can record this spreading.
claims.scope: General boundary process; displayed ages and constant rates are synthetic.

source_refs.locator: Plate boundary explanation and magnetic stripe discussion

object_craft.structure: Build two plate slabs with a narrow central creation zone, simplified upper mantle and a cut side face; mark vertical exaggeration and layers as schematic.
object_craft.material: Matte rock slabs with a separate age legend; central warm accent identifies the authored creation zone without claiming a computed temperature.
